req.title: Retrieve all players
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /players with a JSON array of all players in the database.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates GET /players/ returns HTTP 200 with a JSON array of all Player objects. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — nominal call returns 200 + array of 26 pre-loaded players with correct field shapes; (2) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method (POST without body) returns 4xx, not 200; (3) boundary BVA — exact count of 26 rows, then after adding one player the count becomes exactly 27; (4) DT — cache header X-Cache is MISS on first call and HIT on second call (decision table for cache branch); (5) STC — state transition: pre-load → create → GET reflects new player in array. All assertions use exact values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_get_all_players_returns_200_and_json_array_of_26
preconditions: Database contains exactly 26 pre-loaded players (squad numbers 1-26)
FastAPI app is running in-process via TestClient
expected: Response body is a JSON array
Each element contains keys: id, firstName, lastName, squadNumber, position
trace: R-PLAYER-001: system shall respond to GET /players with a JSON array of all players
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_all_players_returns_200_and_json_array_of_26():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) == 26
    first = body[0]
    for key in ('id', 'firstName', 'lastName', 'squadNumber', 'position'):
        assert key in first, f'Missing key: {key}'

test_get_all_players_returns_200_and_json_array_of_26()

tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_all_players_response_fields_match_preloaded_row():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    players = r.json()
    squad1 = next((p for p in players if p['squadNumber'] == 1), None)
    assert squad1 is not None
    assert squad1['firstName'] == 'Anjali'
    assert squad1['lastName'] == 'Banerjee'
    assert squad1['id'] == '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802'
    assert squad1['starting11'] == False
    assert squad1['position'] == 'Defensive Midfield'
    assert squad1['league'] == 'Serie A'

test_get_all_players_response_fields_match_preloaded_row()

tests.name: test_get_all_players_count_increases_by_exactly_one_after_create
expected: New player with squadNumber 27 appears in the array
trace: R-PLAYER-001: array reflects all players including newly created ones
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_all_players_count_increases_by_exactly_one_after_create():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r_before = client.get('/players/')
    assert r_before.status_code == 200
    before = r_before.json()
    assert len(before) == 26
    payload = {
        'firstName': 'Test', 'lastName': 'Player',
        'squadNumber': 27, 'position': 'Goalkeeper'
    }
    r_post = client.post('/players/', json=payload)
    assert r_post.status_code == 201
    r_after = client.get('/players/')
    assert r_after.status_code == 200
    after = r_after.json()
    assert len(after) == len(before) + 1
    assert len(after) == 27
    squad27 = next((p for p in after if p['squadNumber'] == 27), None)
    assert squad27 is not None
    assert squad27['firstName'] == 'Test'

test_get_all_players_count_increases_by_exactly_one_after_create()

tests.name: test_get_all_players_cache_miss_then_hit
preconditions: Cache may or may not be warm; we use a fresh TestClient per call to avoid shared state issues
actions: Send first GET /players/ — expect X-Cache: MISS
Send second GET /players/ immediately — expect X-Cache: HIT
Both calls must return HTTP 200 and identical arrays
expected: Both responses: status 200, same number of players
trace: R-PLAYER-001: GET /players/ returns 200 + array; cache branch decision table
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_all_players_cache_miss_then_hit():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r1 = client.get('/players/')
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    assert r1.headers.get('x-cache') == 'MISS'
    body1 = r1.json()
    assert isinstance(body1, list)
    assert len(body1) == 26
    r2 = client.get('/players/')
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    assert r2.headers.get('x-cache') == 'HIT'
    body2 = r2.json()
    assert len(body2) == 26
    assert len(body1) == len(body2)

test_get_all_players_cache_miss_then_hit()

expected: Every player has id (str/UUID format), firstName (str), lastName (str), squadNumber (int), position (str)
trace: R-PLAYER-001: JSON array of Player objects — each object must conform to PlayerResponseModel
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import uuid

def test_get_all_players_each_object_has_required_fields_with_correct_types():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    players = r.json()
    assert len(players) == 26
    for p in players:
        assert isinstance(p['id'], str)
        uuid.UUID(p['id'])  # raises ValueError if not valid UUID
        assert isinstance(p['firstName'], str)
        assert isinstance(p['lastName'], str)
        assert isinstance(p['squadNumber'], int)
        assert isinstance(p['position'], str)

test_get_all_players_each_object_has_required_fields_with_correct_types()
